content.text:
I submitted **index 12 (Sb fraction 0.389)**, which had the highest EQE I measured: **0.122%**. All 5 EQE measurements are used. I used 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.18 | 0.010 |
| 10 | 0.32 | 0.097 |
| **12** | **0.39** | **0.122** |
| 21 | 0.66 | 0.0018 |
| 27 | 0.79 | 0.0038 |

- **My first guess was wrong.** I started at index 21, near NiSb₂O₆, the compound I expected to be the active phase. It was one of the weakest samples.
- **Where the best compositions are:** EQE rises about tenfold from Sb 0.18 to 0.32–0.39, then drops sharply on the Sb-rich side.
- **What XRD showed:** indices 7, 10 and 13 (Sb 0.25–0.42) gave nearly identical patterns, so the phases present don't change across that range. That meant XRD couldn't help me decide where to place the last EQE measurement.

The true optimum could be slightly higher in Sb than index 12, around Sb 0.39–0.45 (indices 13–14). EQE was still rising at index 12, and I had no measurements left to check beyond it.
